company.title: Company
company.description: Company name to search jobs for.

careerUrl.title: Career page URL
careerUrl.description: Optional. Paste a company careers/jobs URL for more reliable results. Leave blank to auto-discover from the company name.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Optional multi-company mode. Each item can include name and careerUrl. If set, this overrides the single company field.

keywords.title: Search keywords
keywords.description: Search terms to run on the target company's careers page.

locations.title: Preferred locations
locations.description: Location words used for ranking. The actor does not submit your resume or personal data.

minScore.title: Minimum match score
minScore.description: Only save jobs with at least this score.

entryLevelBoost.title: Boost entry-level roles
entryLevelBoost.description: Give extra ranking weight to entry-level and early-career jobs.
